programme.title: Tenali Rama
programme.desc: Tenali Rama is a historical comedy drama, based on the life of the Telugu poet of the same name. Ramas unparalleled wisdom is at odds with his laziness. After infuriating his loved ones with his casual attitude towards life, he soon awakens to his true identity, where he goes on to use his intelligence to help his king and the subjects overcome their challenges and lead happier lives. Rama is loved by all and feared by his enemies, but he proves once again that good always triumphs over evil!

A must-watch show for all families and age groups, which will make you laugh out loud!
